The '''Red Light Sector Concourse''' was a marketplace and public plaza in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Concourse was one of the only sections of the Red Light Sector that was not overrun by the [[Bleeder]] gangs, and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] security forces patrolled the area to ensure that it remained as such.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Red Light Sector Concourse appears as part of the Red Light Sector on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
